In Retail & Consumer Goods, agentic ai & hyperautomation turns knowledge work into orchestrated autonomy. That is the baseline pattern; the differentiator is what it connects to: agentic process automation, digital workforce & multi-agent orchestration, decision intelligence systems — delivered on Achala Swarm and Achala Nexus and Achala Compass with the sector's regulatory posture built in.

items: Replenishment and allocation by rules of thumb
Store allocation, DC replenishment and size-curve decisions run on legacy heuristics; phantom availability and overstock coexist across the network.
PO changes, OTIF exceptions and forecast sharing run on email chains; supplier risk surfaces as missed deliveries.
Batch demand models react to last week; promotions, weather and local events shift baskets daily. Markdown decisions and replenishment both inherit the lag.

blocks.x: How we deliver it in this sector

The delivery pattern composes 7 services from the Agentic AI & Hyperautomation tower — Agentic Process Automation, Digital Workforce & Multi-Agent Orchestration, Decision Intelligence Systems, Intelligent Document Processing as the usual core — sequenced through the Achala Method with sector controls: CSRD/ISSB-adjacent reporting obligations shape the design from the first sprint.

items: Agents that execute the work — tool-using, policy-bounded, and replayable for audit.
Hundreds of agents as one governed fleet — roles, queues, budgets and audit for the AI workforce.
Enterprise decisions in milliseconds — decision hubs with policy, evidence and replay built in.
Contracts, claims and invoices read end-to-end — extraction, validation and downstream action.
store/DC replenishment with size-curve logic proposed for planner approval (OOS down, overstock down simultaneously)
PO changes, OTIF misses and forecast revisions orchestrated with supplier portals (email chains replaced by governed events)
clean-room verified for every major campaign
